about: The Workbench icons of the Starfighter drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Starfighter's own program icon (misc/starfighter.png, by Layla Marchant from the game's ship sprites by Lamoot and Daniel Cook: CC BY-SA 3.0 / CC BY 3.0, see LICENSES). Starfighter-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Starfighter.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Starfighter.info. Data.info is the icon of every subdrawer (gfx, sound, music, data and Settings): the Makefile copies it to each name.
